name: pi-antiloop
description: 1.10.0: hideStatus hides every antiloop indicator (status line + custom footer + esc+a shortcut) without disabling detection, notifications or interventions, and antiloop never clears a footer it did not install — ctx.ui.setFooter(undefined) restores pi's
